title: Codewars 6kyu: Multiples of 3 or 5
description: If we list all the natural numbers below 10 that are multiples of 3 or 5, we get 3, 5, 6 and 9. The sum of these multiples is 23. Finish the solution so that it returns the sum of all the multiples of 3 or 5 below the number passed in. If the number is negative, return 0.
constraints:
number <= 10^7
• Time: O(1) or O(N) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Sums numbers < number that are divisible by 3 or 5 in O(N) time.
